mcp_call_tool_prefix.name: mcp_call_tool_prefix
mcp_call_tool_prefix.value: ("mcp_call"."tool" GLOB 'core_?*' OR "mcp_call"."tool" GLOB 'study_?*' OR "mcp_call"."tool" GLOB 'career_?*') AND "mcp_call"."tool" NOT GLOB '*[^a-z_]*'

learn_course_module_range.name: learn_course_module_range
learn_course_module_range.value: typeof("learn_course"."module") = 'integer' AND "learn_course"."module" BETWEEN 1 AND 4 AND ("learn_course"."level" = 'specialized' OR "learn_course"."module" = 1)

career_education_start_format.name: career_education_start_format
career_education_start_format.value: ("career_education"."start_on" GLOB '[0-9][0-9][0-9][0-9]' OR ("career_education"."start_on" GLOB '[0-9][0-9][0-9][0-9]-[0-1][0-9]' AND substr("career_education"."start_on", 6, 2) BETWEEN '01' AND '12'))

career_experience_start_format.name: career_experience_start_format
career_experience_start_format.value: ("career_experience"."start_on" GLOB '[0-9][0-9][0-9][0-9]' OR ("career_experience"."start_on" GLOB '[0-9][0-9][0-9][0-9]-[0-1][0-9]' AND substr("career_experience"."start_on", 6, 2) BETWEEN '01' AND '12'))

career_search_criteria_lists.name: career_search_criteria_lists
career_search_criteria_lists.value: json_valid("career_search_criteria"."queries_json") AND json_type("career_search_criteria"."queries_json") = 'array' AND json_valid("career_search_criteria"."lanes_json") AND json_type("career_search_criteria"."lanes_json") = 'array' AND json_valid("career_search_criteria"."shapes_json") AND json_type("career_search_criteria"."shapes_json") = 'array' AND json_valid("career_search_criteria"."auto_reject_json") AND json_type("career_search_criteria"."auto_reject_json") = 'array' AND json_valid("career_search_criteria"."sources_json") AND json_type("career_search_criteria"."sources_json") = 'array'

career_story_parts_length.name: career_story_parts_length
career_story_parts_length.value: length("career_story"."situation") <= 600 AND length("career_story"."task") <= 600 AND length("career_story"."action") <= 600 AND length("career_story"."result") <= 600
